import json
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(r'$BENCHMARK_ROOT')
selection=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/audit/task28_pg_elliptic_backbone_specific_validation500_selection.json').read_text())
# Execute only the archived inference-helper module; discover/selection/training are never called.
exec(compile(selection['validation']['common_source'],'<archived-read-only-helpers>','exec'),globals())
import subprocess
import time
from gnnexplainer_benchmark.evaluation.sparsity import compute_sparsity

OUT=AUDIT/'task28_pg_elliptic_full30_raw_final200_case_study.json'
CSV=AUDIT/'task28_pg_elliptic_full30_raw_final200_per_target.csv'
TARGET=ROOT/'configs/targets/elliptic_xai_common_test_targets.csv'
MODE='FULL30_RAW_LOGIT_RANKING'
METRICS=['FidelityPlus','FidelityMinus','OneMinusFidelityMinus','delta_remove','p_original','p_remove','p_retain','retain_delta','retain_ratio','sparsity','selected_ratio']
counts=guards();start=time.perf_counter()
assert sha256(TARGET)=='e414941e6943b06484ecd5028c51daf80ff2bf9f1bbb06e6a5fd816de8dfb9c0'
with TARGET.open(newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f:target_rows=list(csv.DictReader(f))
nodes=[int(r['node_id']) for r in target_rows];assert len(nodes)==len(set(nodes))==200
assert not set(nodes)&set(selection['protocol']['validation_pool'])
assert selection['status']=='COMPLETE' and selection['selection']=={'GCN':None,'GraphSAGE':'SAGE_HIST_FULL30_RAW'}
verify='--verify' in sys.argv
if verify:
    d=json.loads(OUT.read_text());assert d['status']=='PENDING_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION';assert d['protocol']['target_order']==nodes
else:
    assert not OUT.exists() and not OUT.with_suffix('.md').exists() and not CSV.exists(),'NO_OVERWRITE'
    protected={r['path']:r['after_sha256'] for r in selection['validation']['scientific_file_hashes']}
    for f in [AUDIT/'task28_pg_elliptic_backbone_specific_validation500_selection.json',AUDIT/'task28_pg_elliptic_backbone_specific_validation500_selection.md',MANIFEST,TARGET]:protected[str(f)]=sha256(f)
    assert all(sha256(Path(f))==h for f,h in protected.items())
    protocol=dict(mode=MODE,method='OTHER_ORIGINAL_PYG_HARD_CE_SUM',epochs=30,updates=60000,seed=42,
        target_path=str(TARGET),target_SHA256=sha256(TARGET),target_order=nodes,determinism_subset=nodes[:20],target_source_rows=target_rows,
        inference='same historical float32 raw logits; restrict canonical2hop; CPU torch.topk descending; NO sigmoid/centering/clipping/rescaling',
        scope_hops=2,top_ratio=.2,k_rule='max(1,ceil(.2*N))',metric_sources=[str(Path(fidelity.__file__)),str(ROOT/'src/gnnexplainer_benchmark/evaluation/sparsity.py')],
        definitions={'FidelityPlus':'remove_prediction != original_prediction','FidelityMinus':'retain_prediction != original_prediction','OneMinusFidelityMinus':'retain_prediction == original_prediction','delta_remove':'p_original-p_remove','retain_delta':'p_original-p_retain','retain_ratio':'p_retain/p_original','sparsity':'1-selected_count/candidate_count'},
        Random_status='NOT_REPORTED; optional descriptive reference omitted; no Random generated or used for decisions',
        roles={'GCN':dict(PriorValidationStatus='GCN_NO_VALIDATION_SUPPORTED_PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE',Final200Role='DIAGNOSTIC_DESCRIPTIVE_CASE_STUDY'),
               'GraphSAGE':dict(PriorValidationStatus='SAGE_VALIDATION_SUPPORTED_PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE',Final200Role='VALIDATION_SUPPORTED_CASE_STUDY_RESULT')},
        no_training=True,no_finetuning=True,no_optimizer=True,no_checkpoint_selection=True,no_secondary_test_modes=True,no_post_test_tuning=True,terminal_branch=True)
    d=dict(status='PREDECLARED',protocol=protocol,predeclaration_SHA256=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(protocol,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(),
        per_target={},aggregate={},receipts={},verdicts={},validation=dict(protected_before_hashes=protected,
        checkpoint_inventory={str(f):[f.stat().st_size,f.stat().st_mtime_ns] for root in [ROOT/'artifacts',BASE/'artifacts'] for f in root.rglob('*.pt')},
        runner_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),archived_helper_source=selection['validation']['common_source'],OptimizerConstructed=False,OptimizerSteps=0,BackwardCalls=0,hidden_retries=0,evaluation_restarts=0))
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'/n',encoding='utf-8')
data_cpu=load_data();data=data_cpu.clone().to('cuda:0');E=data.edge_index.size(1)
def explain(pg,emb,node):
    mask=computation_subgraph_edge_mask(data_cpu,node,2);ids=torch.nonzero(mask).flatten()
    with torch.no_grad():raw=pg.mlp(pg._get_inputs(emb,data.edge_index,node)).view(-1)[mask.to('cuda:0')].cpu()
    assert raw.dtype==torch.float32 and torch.isfinite(raw).all()
    k=max(1,math.ceil(.2*len(ids)));fs=torch.zeros(E);fs[mask]=raw;sm,_=select_top_ratio_edges(fs,mask,.2)
    assert sorted(ids[torch.topk(raw,k).indices].tolist())==torch.nonzero(sm).flatten().tolist()
    sp=compute_sparsity(mask,sm,k);st=summary(raw);local=sm[mask]
    sep=float(raw[local].mean()-raw[~local].mean()) if (~local).any() else 0.
    nontrivial=st['std']>1e-4 and st['P80_minus_P20']>1e-4 and 0<k<len(ids) and sep>0 and st['max']>st['min']
    return dict(node_id=node,candidate_edge_count=len(ids),selected_k=k,selected_ratio=k/len(ids),sparsity=sp.sparsity,
        candidate_global_edge_indices=ids.tolist(),selected_global_edge_indices=torch.nonzero(sm).flatten().tolist(),raw_logits=raw.tolist(),raw_statistics=st,
        raw_nontrivial=bool(nontrivial),raw_top20_separation=sep,boundary_tie=bool(raw[local].min()==raw[~local].max()) if (~local).any() else True),sm
def perturb(model,node,sm,independent=False):
    if independent:
        # Explicit physical graphs and original-class probability, independent of compute_fidelity.
        original=fidelity.predict_node(model,data,node);remove=data.clone();remove.edge_index=data.edge_index[:,~sm.to('cuda:0')]
        retain=data.clone();retain.edge_index=data.edge_index[:,sm.to('cuda:0')]
        a=fidelity.predict_node(model,remove,node,original.prediction);z=fidelity.predict_node(model,retain,node,original.prediction)
        p,q,t=original.probability,a.probability,z.probability;o,aa,zz=original.prediction,a.prediction,z.prediction
        plus=fidelity.fid_plus(o,aa);minus=fidelity.fid_minus(o,zz)
        return dict(p_original=p,p_remove=q,p_retain=t,original_predicted_class=o,remove_predicted_class=aa,retain_predicted_class=zz,
            FidelityPlus=plus,FidelityMinus=minus,OneMinusFidelityMinus=1-minus,delta_remove=p-q,remove_flip=plus,retain_delta=p-t,retain_ratio=t/p,retain_preserved=1-minus)
    f=fidelity.compute_fidelity(model,data,node,sm.to('cuda:0'))
    return dict(p_original=f.original_probability,p_remove=f.remove_probability,p_retain=f.retain_probability,
        original_predicted_class=f.original_prediction,remove_predicted_class=f.remove_prediction,retain_predicted_class=f.retain_prediction,
        FidelityPlus=f.fid_plus,FidelityMinus=f.fid_minus,OneMinusFidelityMinus=f.one_minus_fid_minus,
        delta_remove=f.remove_probability_drop,remove_flip=f.fid_plus,retain_delta=f.retain_delta,retain_ratio=f.retain_probability_ratio,retain_preserved=f.one_minus_fid_minus)
def aggregate_final(rows):
    a={m:float(np.mean([r[m] for r in rows])) for m in METRICS}
    a.update(TargetCount=len(rows),MeanCandidateEdges=float(np.mean([r['candidate_edge_count'] for r in rows])),MeanSelectedEdges=float(np.mean([r['selected_k'] for r in rows])),
        RawNontrivialFraction=float(np.mean([r['raw_nontrivial'] for r in rows])),BoundaryTieCount=sum(r['boundary_tie'] for r in rows),
        SuccessfulTargets=len(rows),FailedTargets=0,determinism_targets=20)
    return a
for b in ['GCN','GraphSAGE']:
    rc=prior['receipts'][b];c=dict(backbone=b,family='HISTORICAL_FULL30_RAW',checkpoint_path=rc['checkpoint_path'],MLP_hash=rc['MLPBeforeHash'])
    file=Path(c['checkpoint_path']);assert sha256(file)==rc['CheckpointHash']==prior['protocol']['expected_checkpoint_hashes'][b]
    saved=torch.load(file,map_location='cpu',weights_only=False);assert saved['epochs_completed']==30 and saved['seed']==42 and len(saved['train_node_ids'])==2000
    assert all(int(st['step'])==60000 for st in saved['optimizer_state_dict']['state'].values())
    model,dim=backbone_load(b,data_cpu);bh=tensor_hash(model.state_dict());pg=pgload(c,dim);mh=tensor_hash(pg.mlp.state_dict())
    with torch.no_grad():emb=get_embeddings(model,data.x,data.edge_index)[-1].detach()
    rows=[]
    for i,node in enumerate(nodes):
        r,sm=explain(pg,emb,node);r.update(perturb(model,node,sm,verify));r.update(backbone=b,inference_mode=MODE,success=True)
        assert r['candidate_edge_count']==int(target_rows[i]['candidate_edge_count']) and target_rows[i]['candidate_mapping_valid']=='True'
        r['determinism_PASS']=None
        if node in nodes[:20]:
            rr,ss=explain(pg,emb,node);rr.update(perturb(model,node,ss,verify))
            deterministic=rr['raw_logits']==r['raw_logits'] and rr['selected_global_edge_indices']==r['selected_global_edge_indices'] and all(rr[k]==r[k] for k in ['p_original','p_remove','p_retain'])
            if not deterministic:
                d['status']='FINAL200_DETERMINISM_FAILURE';OUT.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'/n');raise RuntimeError('FINAL200_DETERMINISM_FAILURE')
            r['determinism_PASS']=True
        if verify:
            old=d['per_target'][b][i]
            for k in r:
                if isinstance(r[k],float):assert abs(r[k]-old[k])<=1e-6,'FINAL200_VERIFIER_MISMATCH'
                else:assert r[k]==old[k],'FINAL200_VERIFIER_MISMATCH'
        rows.append(r)
        if (i+1)%50==0:print('VERIFY' if verify else 'EVAL',b,i+1,flush=True)
    ag=aggregate_final(rows);assert tensor_hash(pg.mlp.state_dict())==mh and tensor_hash(model.state_dict())==bh
    receipt=dict(PGCheckpointHash=sha256(file),BackboneHash=sha256(Path(prior['backbones'][b]['checkpoint_path'])),Epochs=30,Updates=60000,InferenceMode=MODE,
        MLPBeforeHash=mh,MLPAfterHash=tensor_hash(pg.mlp.state_dict()),backbone_before_hash=bh,backbone_after_hash=tensor_hash(model.state_dict()),wrapper_parity=True,max_logit_diff=0.,prediction_mismatch=0,
        parameters_frozen=True,OptimizerConstructed=False,OptimizerSteps=0,BackwardCalls=0,Status='PASS')
    if verify:
        assert receipt==d['receipts'][b]
        for k,v in ag.items():assert abs(v-d['aggregate'][b][k])<=1e-12,'FINAL200_VERIFIER_MISMATCH'
    else:
        d['per_target'][b]=rows;d['aggregate'][b]=ag;d['receipts'][b]=receipt
        OUT.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'/n',encoding='utf-8')
    del pg,model,emb,saved;torch.cuda.empty_cache()
assert all(v==0 for v in counts.values())
for f,h in d['validation']['protected_before_hashes'].items():assert sha256(Path(f))==h
inventory={str(f):[f.stat().st_size,f.stat().st_mtime_ns] for root in [ROOT/'artifacts',BASE/'artifacts'] for f in root.rglob('*.pt')};assert inventory==d['validation']['checkpoint_inventory']
assert d['predeclaration_SHA256']==hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(d['protocol'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
assert subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True).returncode==0
if verify:
    d['validation']['independent_verification']=dict(Status='PASS',actual_target_records=400,physical_perturbation_evaluations=440,determinism_targets=40,
        raw_vectors_and_sets_exact=True,probability_tolerance=1e-6,independent_physical_graph_construction=True,OptimizerConstructed=False,OptimizerSteps=0,BackwardCalls=0,
        runner_source=Path(__file__).read_text())
    d['status']='VERIFIED_PENDING_REPORT'
else:
    d['validation'].update(scientific_file_hashes=[dict(path=f,before_sha256=h,after_sha256=sha256(Path(f))) for f,h in d['validation']['protected_before_hashes'].items()],
        protected_files_unchanged=True,checkpoint_inventory_unchanged=True,finite_outputs=True,JSON_parse_PASS=True,git_diff_check_PASS=True,runtime_seconds=time.perf_counter()-start)
    d['status']='PENDING_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION'
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'/n',encoding='utf-8');print('FINAL200_VERIFY_PASS' if verify else 'FINAL200_RUN_DONE',d['aggregate'],flush=True)
